about: ADR-0059 Decision 10, items 1 to 3 and 8: each text or operation directory a persona region, or an authored orchestrator command or skill, makes, the blocks that read it, and every path through the command, with the releasing step (release) or the reason it is kept (keep). tests/plugin-shape/test-runbook-cli-contracts.mjs holds the rendered regions, and each orchestrator file a group names in `files` (checked whole: it renders no region), to this list both ways (tmpdirProblems in tests/_runbook-checks.mjs). A block is named by a pattern of its text; a directory by the variable the releasing block gives the release. optional_consumers: consumers some runbooks lack (an authored block of one persona). instead_of: blocks that run in place of the releasing block, on another path of the command, never after it. guard: the if condition a release runs under, when it has one (an end release, or an exit release from its trap that the guard limits to the paths it authorizes, as next's three results do: the list then both keeps and releases it). at: end (on the block's success path, after its last exit and its last other use of the variable), exit (on each of the block's exits, from its EXIT trap), exit-failed (on its failing exits only). authored: each persona file whose authored text (its region bodies aside) tells the agent to make a directory, and the step that releases it (region:<id>, a region the file renders, or the authored sentence); held both ways by the same test file. pending: the files or templates that still make a directory the old way (the rollout's remainder). exempt: lines of prose an owner follows outside any runbook block, by file and text, each found exactly once.
